第28章 请跟我走一趟，配合调查-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

“你好，110。”

“你好，我要举报一个涉嫌利用自媒体进行商业诽谤和敲诈勒索的人，目标在朝阳区望京SOHOT1塔楼北侧广场……”

“好的先生，请您在原地等候，我们会尽快派人过来。”

挂了电话，他靠在柱子上等了起来。

几分钟后，主播那边接了个电话后就忽然停了下来。

刘卫东摘下领夹麦克风，对助手说了句什么，然后开始收折叠椅和支架。

要走？

顾承安从系统空间取了个口罩戴上，然后走了过去。

“刘老师？我是您粉丝，刚才一直在旁边看您直播，能合个影吗？”

刘卫东看了他一眼，摆摆手：“今天就不了，赶时间。”

“一张就行，十秒钟的事，我关注您老久了。”

“不好意思兄弟，真有事。”刘卫东把手机塞进口袋，背上包，招呼助手跟上，拔腿就走。

顾承安跟了两步：“刘老师，其实我刚才已经报警了。”

刘卫东脚步一顿，转过身来。

“你说什么？”

“我说我报了警，怀疑你涉嫌利用自媒体进行虚假宣传，等警察来了当面说清楚就行。”

刘卫东的表情从意外变成了恼怒：“你谁啊你？你凭什么报警？我做自媒体犯法了？言论自由懂不懂？”

“懂，所以你等一下，让警察来判断，不就清楚了。”

“我没时间跟你在这耗！”刘卫东推开顾承安的手臂就要走，力气还不小，“神经病吧你——”

他的手刚推到顾承安胸口，就被一把抓住了手腕。

动作太快，刘卫东根本没反应过来。下一秒，他的身体被一股不可抗拒的力量带着转了半圈，双手被反剪到背后。

顾承安快速用裤兜掩饰从系统空间掏出一根专用扎带。

撕拉一声，扎带锁死。

整个过程不超过两秒。

刘卫东的助手手里提着的东西掉在地上，愣在原地。

旁边奶茶店门口几个年轻人全看呆了。一个姑娘举着手机，也不知道是在拍还是忘了放下。

“你干什么！你放开我！这是非法拘禁！我要告你！”刘卫东开始大喊大叫。

顾承安松开手，退后一步。

“你可以告，但是在警察来之前，你哪也去不了。”

几个路人围了过来，交头接耳。有人在拍视频，有人在问怎么回事。

"Hello, 110."

"Hello, I want to report a person who is suspected of using self-media to carry out commercial defamation and extortion. The target is the square on the north side of Wangjing SOHOT1 Tower, Chaoyang District..."

"Okay sir, please wait where you are and we will send someone over as soon as possible."

After hanging up the phone, he leaned against the pillar and waited.

A few minutes later, the anchor suddenly stopped after receiving a call.

Liu Weidong took off his lapel microphone, said something to his assistant, and then began to put away the folding chairs and stands.

Want to leave?

Gu Chengan took a mask from the system space and put it on, then walked over.

"Teacher Liu? I am your fan and I have been watching your live broadcast just now. Can I take a photo with you?"

Liu Weidong glanced at him and waved his hand: "Not today, I'm in a hurry."

"Just one picture, it only takes ten seconds. I have been following you for a long time."

"I'm sorry, brother, something really happened." Liu Weidong stuffed his cell phone into his pocket, put his bag on his back, asked his assistant to follow him, and left.

Gu Chengan followed two steps: "Teacher Liu, actually I just called the police."

Liu Weidong paused and turned around.

"What did you say?"

"I said that I called the police and suspected that you were suspected of using self-media to carry out false propaganda. I just waited until the police came and explained it to me in person."

Liu Weidong's expression changed from surprise to anger: "Who are you? Why do you call the police? I broke the law by doing self-media? Do you understand freedom of speech?"

"I understand, so just wait a moment and let the police decide. Then it will be clear."

"I don't have time to waste time with you here!" Liu Weidong pushed Gu Chengan's arm away and was about to leave. He was not weak at all, "You're crazy, you-"

As soon as his hand reached Gu Chengan's chest, his wrist was grabbed.

The movement was so fast that Liu Weidong didn't react at all.The next second, his body was turned half a circle by an irresistible force, and his hands were cut behind his back.

Gu Chengan quickly used his trouser pocket to cover up and took out a special cable tie from the system space.

With a tearing sound, the tie was locked.

The whole process takes no more than two seconds.

Liu Weidong's assistant dropped what he was carrying and froze on the spot.

Several young people at the door of the milk tea shop nearby were all stunned.A girl was holding up her mobile phone, not sure if she was taking pictures or if she forgot to put it down.

"What are you doing! Let me go! This is illegal detention! I'm going to sue you!" Liu Weidong started shouting.

Gu Chengan let go of his hand and took a step back.

"You can sue, but you can't go anywhere until the police come."

Several passers-by gathered around and whispered to each other.Someone was taking a video, someone was asking what was going on.
